calendar.name: SETSUBUN
calendar.tagline: Out with the demons. Handful by handful.
calendar.rule: ONI hates small things thrown often: logs of 30 minutes or less hit for double.

calendar.name: VALENTINE
calendar.tagline: Someone has been studying very hard, for someone.
calendar.rule: CHOCO is studying to impress one person and will not lose. BITTER, the boss, dodges every fourth hit.

calendar.name: HANAMI
calendar.tagline: The blossoms only stay a little while.
calendar.rule: FUBUKI is the storm that strips the trees: it grows back after every empty day. SAKURA, the transfer student, stays until the last petal.

calendar.name: TANABATA
calendar.tagline: Two stars, one night a year.
calendar.rule: The RIVER OF HEAVEN is a dragon of stars with one head per subject: each log only reaches its own.

calendar.name: SUMMER BREAK
calendar.tagline: There is plenty of time. There was.
calendar.rule: AUGUST 31 is the deadline itself: every empty day it grows back two hours.

calendar.name: TSUKIMI
calendar.tagline: Look up. Someone up there is keeping count.
calendar.rule: TSUKUYOMI rules the night and heals an hour at every midnight. USAGI pounds rice on the moon between lessons.

calendar.name: HALLOWEEN
calendar.tagline: Some things only come out after dark.
calendar.rule: JACK can only be hit at night: logs committed from 05:00 to 17:59 pass right through.

calendar.name: CULTURE FESTIVAL
calendar.tagline: The whole school is awake and nothing is ready.
calendar.rule: STAGE FRIGHT only shows itself after dark, the night before you go on. The class president, IINCHO, is running everything.

calendar.name: CHRISTMAS
calendar.tagline: He has one night, and he has not started.
calendar.rule: Log 5 hours from Dec 20 to 24 and a present opens on the 25th: a limited piece, free.

calendar.name: NEW YEAR
calendar.tagline: Start the year with a clean page.
calendar.rule: KAGAMI, the offering come to life, only feels one long sitting: logs under an hour bounce off. MIKO keeps the shrine, and the hours.

buffs.name: WARM-UP
buffs.detail: Every log you commit in the next 48h earns +100 BITS/h until 5 hours are covered (up to +500). A cheap first buff.

buffs.name: NIGHT SHIFT
buffs.detail: For 72h, sessions touching 22:00–02:00 earn +100 BITS/h the first night, +150 the next and +200 the third, up to 3 hours a night (+1,350 in all). Skip a night and the rate drops back to +100.

buffs.name: EARLY BIRD
buffs.tagline: ×3 at dawn — skip a morning and it ends
buffs.detail: The next 3 mornings: sessions touching 05:00–09:00 earn +200 BITS/h, up to 2 hours each morning (+1,200 in all). A morning with no log ends the buff, and whatever is left of it is lost.

buffs.name: MYSTERY CRATE
buffs.tagline: One random buff — maybe a HYPERDRIVE
buffs.detail: Opens into one of the other buffs (not CATEGORY LOCK), which starts right away with its usual rules. Rare ones are rare.

buffs.name: OVERCLOCK
buffs.detail: For the next 24h every log earns +100 BITS/h, up to 10 hours (+1,000). Short and sharp: whatever is left after a day is gone.

buffs.name: STORM RUNNER
buffs.detail: For 5 days, logs committed while the CHRONOMETER weather reads rain, snow, a storm or below 0°C earn +100 BITS/h (up to 10 hours, +1,000). Clear skies pay the usual rate. Needs the weather readout switched on.

buffs.name: FOCUS CHIP
buffs.tagline: +100 per 50-min session — a short log burns it out
buffs.detail: For 72h, each single log of 50 minutes or more earns +100 BITS (up to 12 logs, +1,200). Commit a log under 25 minutes and the chip burns out: the buff ends.

buffs.name: CATEGORY LOCK
buffs.detail: Pick a category: for 72h its logs earn +100 BITS/h (up to 12 hours, +1,200). Logs in other categories earn the usual rate.

buffs.name: LUNAR TIDE
buffs.tagline: Pays with the moon — ×2 at full
buffs.detail: For 96h, each log earns extra BITS in step with the moon: +100 BITS/h at full moon, about +50 at a half moon, close to nothing at new moon (up to 12 hours). Check the LUNAR CALENDAR before you buy.

buffs.name: WEEKEND SURGE
buffs.detail: Sessions touching this Saturday and Sunday earn +50 BITS/h (up to 24 hours, +1,200). Buy it any day — it holds your buff slot until Sunday ends.

buffs.name: LUCKY BYTE
buffs.detail: For 72h, each log has a 1-in-5 chance to pay triple (up to 3h of it counts; up to 20 logs).

buffs.name: DEEP DIVE
buffs.tagline: The longer the session, the bigger the haul
buffs.detail: For 96h, each single log pays by its length: 2h or more earns +300, 3h +450 and 4h +700 (up to 4 logs, +2,800). Shorter logs pay nothing extra and use nothing up.

buffs.name: IRON CONTRACT
buffs.tagline: 3 days × 5h: pays ×2 — or keeps the stake
buffs.detail: Starts at midnight and runs 3 calendar days. Log 5 hours or more on every one of them (a session past midnight counts for the day it started, if committed by 03:00) and the log that completes day 3 pays twice the stake (+3,000). Miss a single day and the stake is gone. Cancelling refunds nothing.

buffs.name: HYPERDRIVE
buffs.tagline: ×2 on 25 hours — if you keep up 3h a day
buffs.detail: Every log you commit in the next 96h earns +100 BITS/h until 25 hours are covered (up to +2,500). Every full day it runs needs 3 hours of logs (a session past midnight counts for the day it started, if committed by 03:00), or the drive shuts down.

active_challenge.name: WARDEN
active_challenge.title: KEEPER OF THE STREAK
active_challenge.trait_line: A full day without a log heals it 2 hours.

raids.name: WARDEN
raids.title: KEEPER OF THE STREAK
raids.trait_line: A full day without a log heals it 2 hours.

raids.name: HYDRA
raids.title: THREE HEADS, THREE SUBJECTS
raids.trait_line: One head per category: a log only hits its own.

raids.name: TITAN
raids.title: THE LONG WAR
raids.trait_line: 30 hours of HP and a week to bring it down.

rivals.name: MIKA
rivals.motto: Every stop on the train is a page.

offer.name: MIKA // INVERTED
offer.tag: MISSED THE LAST TRAIN ON PURPOSE
offer.motto: Every stop. Every day. No days off.
offer.rule_line: Win all three rounds, or you lose the duel.

rivals.name: NOVA
rivals.motto: The night is where the work is.

rivals.name: KAI
rivals.motto: Twenty-five on, five off. All day.

rivals.name: ORION
rivals.motto: Four hours a day. Every day.

rivals.name: ACE
rivals.motto: Second place is just the first to lose.
